keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «아이에게 쉬운 일이 로봇에게는 매우 어렵다(수수께끼)» 와 «가정용 로봇은 이미 우리를 돕고, 쉬운 기술을 배우면서 더 큰 역할을 할 것이다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the puzzle (jobs that are easy for a child are very hard for robots) and the conclusion (home robots already help us and will play a bigger role as they learn). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why is it hard for a robot to fold clothes?
qs.qko: 로봇이 옷을 개기 어려운 이유는 무엇인가요?
opts: Because soft clothes keep changing shape, so it cannot predict how to grab them
Because clothes are too heavy for robots to lift
Because robots are not allowed to touch clothes
evs: Soft objects keep changing shape, so a robot cannot easily predict how to grab them.
Robot vacuum cleaners became popular in the early 2000s, and many use sensors to map rooms and avoid stairs.
Jobs that are hard for people, such as solving huge math problems, can be easy for computers.
Engineers now let robots practice thousands of times, just like children learn.
why: 부드러운 물건은 계속 모양이 바뀌어서 로봇이 어떻게 잡아야 할지 쉽게 예측할 수 없다고 했어요.
Soft objects keep changing shape, so a robot cannot easily predict how to grab them.

qs.q: In "they will play a bigger role in our lives," what does "play a bigger role" mean?
qs.qko: «they will play a bigger role in our lives» 에서 «play a bigger role» 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: become more important and do more jobs
evs: One day, robots may cook, do laundry, and care for people, but we will also need to think about privacy and safety.
So why can it not fold your T-shirt?
Jobs that are hard for people, such as solving huge math problems, can be easy for computers.
Our hands and brains do this so naturally that we never notice how difficult it is.
why: 바로 앞 문장에서 로봇이 언젠가 요리하고 빨래하고 사람을 돌볼지도 모른다고 했어요. 그러니 «play a bigger role» 은 우리 삶에서 «더 중요한 일을 많이 맡는다» 는 뜻이에요.
The sentence before says robots may cook, do laundry, and care for people, so «play a bigger role» means they will become more important and do more jobs.

qs.q: What is the strange puzzle that engineers discovered?
opts: Jobs that are hard for people can be easy for computers, but jobs that are easy for a child are hard for robots
Robots can fold clothes but cannot explore Mars
Children solve huge math problems faster than computers
evs: Jobs that are hard for people, such as solving huge math problems, can be easy for computers.
Robot vacuum cleaners became popular in the early 2000s, and many use sensors to map rooms and avoid stairs.
Jobs that are easy for a child, like folding clothes or picking up messy toys, are very hard for robots.
Engineers now let robots practice thousands of times, just like children learn.
why: 사람에게 어려운 일(큰 수학 문제 풀기)은 컴퓨터에게 쉬울 수 있는데, 아이에게 쉬운 일(옷 개기)은 로봇에게 매우 어렵다고 했어요. 두 문장을 함께 봐야 수수께끼가 보여요.
Hard jobs for people, like huge math problems, can be easy for computers, but easy jobs for a child, like folding clothes, are very hard for robots. You need both sentences.

write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you can’t do and what you can do instead in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: 두 칸 모두 «하는 일» 낱말로 시작하게 써 보세요. (예: cook dinner, wash the dishes)
write.moreEn: One more step: start both blanks with an action word. (e.g. cook dinner, wash the dishes)
